name: Mini-SOC Lab Detection Coverage
description: Mini-SOC custom detection rules and automated response coverage layer

techniques.comment: Custom Suricata rules (SID 1000001-1000005) detecting SYN, NULL, XMAS, and FIN port scans + SOAR containment
SSH brute-force detection (SID 1000010) + sliding window correlation + instant iptables auto-block
SQL injection (UNION SELECT / Boolean bypass) & Log4j probe detection + SOAR isolation
Web directory traversal and /etc/passwd disclosure attempt detection
Web shell command execution (/bin/sh, bash) inspection and containment
Automated scanner user-agents (Nikto, sqlmap, Gobuster) fingerprinting
Authorized internal scanner auto-tagging and noise suppression playbook
